questions.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explain: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. The name triangle means three-angled.

questions.question: How many corners does a square have?
questions.explain: A square has 4 corners (vertices) and 4 sides. Count them one by one to be sure.

questions.question: Does a circle have any corners?
questions.explain: A circle is all round with no straight sides, so it has no corners. A common mix-up is to say it has 1 corner, but a corner needs two straight lines meeting.

questions.question: A square has 4 sides. Are all 4 sides the same length?
questions.explain: Every side of a square is the same length. If two sides are long and two are short, that shape is a rectangle, not a square.

questions.question: Emma draws a shape with 4 sides and 4 corners. All 4 sides are the same length. What shape is it?
questions.explain: 4 sides, 4 corners, and all sides the same length means it is a square. A rectangle also has 4 sides but only 2 pairs of equal lengths.

questions.question: A shape has 4 sides and 4 corners. Two sides are long and two sides are short. What shape is it?
questions.explain: 4 sides with 2 long and 2 short is a rectangle. A square would need all 4 sides to be the same length.

questions.question: Jay turns a square so it rests on a corner. Is it still a square?
options: No, it is a rectangle now
No, it is a new shape now
Yes, it is still a square
questions.explain: Turning a shape does not change its sides or corners. A square on a corner still has 4 equal sides and 4 corners, so it is still a square.

questions.question: A triangle is lying on its side and the point faces left. Is it still a triangle?
options: No, it turned into a square
No, it is a rectangle now
No, now it has four sides
Yes, it is still a triangle
questions.explain: A triangle always has 3 sides and 3 corners no matter how it is turned. Lying on its side does not change what it is.

questions.question: A shape has 4 corners, but NOT all 4 sides are the same length. Which shape is it?
questions.explain: A rectangle has 4 corners and 4 sides, but 2 are long and 2 are short. A square would need all 4 sides to match.

questions.question: Sam says: A rectangle has 4 sides that are all the same length. What is wrong with what Sam says?
options: It has no sides and no corners
questions.explain: A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides, so they are not all the same. Sam mixed up a rectangle with a square.

questions.question: A flat shape has 0 sides and 0 corners. What shape is it?
questions.explain: A circle has no straight sides and no corners. The other shapes all have at least 3 sides and 3 corners.

questions.question: Ivy draws 1 triangle and 1 square. She counts every side on both shapes. How many sides does she count in all?
questions.explain: A triangle has 3 sides and a square has 4 sides, so 3 + 4 = 7. Many kids give 8 because they think a triangle has 4 sides.

questions.question: Ben lays a rectangle flat on his desk. Then he turns it to stand up tall. What is true about the shape now?
options: It still has 4 sides and 4 corners.
It has turned into a square shape now.
It is now not a rectangle at all.
It now has 5 sides and 5 corners.
questions.explain: Turning a shape does not change its sides or corners, so it is still a rectangle with 4 sides and 4 corners. A shape never gets a new name just because you move it.

questions.question: Max says: A circle has 1 side and 1 corner. What is wrong with what Max says?
options: A circle has 3 corners like a triangle.
A circle has no sides and no corners.
A circle has 1 corner but 0 sides.
A circle has 4 sides like a square.
questions.explain: A circle is one smooth curve, so it has no straight sides and no corners at all. Kids often say a circle has 1 corner, but there is no point where two sides meet.

questions.question: Ruby's shape has 4 sides and 4 corners. Her friend says it must be a square. Why could Ruby's shape be a rectangle instead?
options: A turned shape always gets a new name.
A square really has more than 4 corners.
Its sides may not all be the same length.
A rectangle has 4 sides all the same length.
questions.explain: Squares and rectangles both have 4 sides and 4 corners, so you must check the side lengths. A square has all 4 sides equal, while a rectangle can have 2 long sides and 2 short sides.
